    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if all(v in (grid[r][0], 9) for v in grid[r])]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] in (9, grid[0][c]) for r in range(h))]
    # Find separator rows/columns by their dominant color.
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) <= 2 and grid[r].count(9) > w//2]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if sum(grid[r][c] == 9 for r in range(h)) > h//2]
    # Junction locations are separator intersections; output each lattice interval
    # using the marker at the upper-left corner, or the ordinary field color.
    rr, cc = rows, cols
    out=[]
    for i in range(len(rr)-1):
        line=[]
        for j in range(len(cc)-1):
            v=grid[rr[i]][cc[j]]
            if v in (0,1,2,5,6,7,8,9) and v != 9:

            else:
                line.append(next((grid[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (9,)),0))
        out.append(line)
    return out
'''
